messages.text: Hadjar to miss Italian GP with ongoing wrist injury

metadata.summary: Isack Hadjar will miss this weekend's Italian Grand Prix due to his ongoing wrist injury, with Liam Lawson replacing him for a second consecutive event at Red Bull.
metadata.content: Isack Hadjar to miss Italian Grand Prix with wrist injury as Liam Lawson gets another Red Bull opportunity at Monza | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Isack Hadjar to miss Italian Grand Prix with wrist injury as Liam Lawson gets another Red Bull opportunity at Monza Red Bull have confirmed Isack Hadjar will miss the Italian Grand Prix as he's yet to recover from his wrist injury; watch Friday's practice sessions for the Italian GP at 11.30am and 3pm, live on Sky Sports F1 Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Wednesday 2 September 2026 15:55, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Look back at some of the most dramatic moments to have taken place at the Italian Grand Prix Isack Hadjar will miss this weekend's Italian Grand Prix due to his ongoing wrist injury, with Liam Lawson replacing him for a second consecutive event at Red Bull. Hadjar suffered the injury while boxing in training during the summer break last month which forced him to miss the Dutch Grand Prix and he has not recovered in time for Monza. With Lawson stepping up to be Max Verstappen's team-mate at Red Bull, Yuki Tsunoda will have another chance to impress at Racing Bulls. messages.text: Hamilton hopeful as Ferrari confirm Italian GP engine upgrade

metadata.summary: Lewis Hamilton hopes Ferrari have the car to fight for the win at their home Italian Grand Prix, a weekend in which they will introduce an engine upgrade for both drivers.
metadata.content: Italian GP: Lewis Hamilton hopeful Ferrari can fight for Monza win as team confirm engine upgrade for home race | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Update Italian GP: Lewis Hamilton hopeful Ferrari can fight for Monza win as team confirm engine upgrade for home race Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc will run a new, upgraded engine at Monza this weekend; Hamilton hopeful home team "can fight for the win"; watch every session of the Italian GP live on Sky Sports F1, starting with Friday's practice sessions at 11.30am and 3pm By James Galloway and Nigel Chiu Wednesday 2 September 2026 18:48, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Ferrari has unveiled its one-off livery, paying tribute to Michael Schumacher, for the Formula 1 Italian Grand Prix at Monza Lewis Hamilton hopes Ferrari have the car to fight for the win at their home Italian Grand Prix, a weekend in which they will introduce an engine upgrade for both drivers. The upgrade will be Ferrari's second on the power unit side this season after they were granted two development opportunities by the FIA. Ferrari endured a disappointing Monza last year, finishing fourth and sixth, but hopes are higher for 2026 amid a more competitive season in which they remain in world title contention.
